protocol.kind: single-step frozen generated latent; NO DiT weight update or trajectory intervention
protocol.negative: same-script different-writer TRAIN prototypes; query character excluded; NOT hard samechar loss
protocol.positive: train-only same-writer different-character, character/source balanced prototype
protocol.prototype_metric: same-script slots only, query character excluded from all prototypes; not the historical shuffled6000 23-way metric

limitations: Only eight preselected glyphs and one seed before eligibility filtering; not full187/multiseed validation.
Pixel D1 and old CE are separate weights, not statistically independent of the training data or shortcuts.
LPIPS/SSIM/InkIoU here compare against original generated image, NOT GT quality.
Small latent steps do not establish trainable DiT controllability or FM-gradient compatibility.
Source directories are proxies; no cross-source generation guarantee.

gradient_concentration.note: Descriptive gradient projections, not causal proof of shortcut use.

pilot_gate.definition: Engineering pilot only, not formal generator-supervision acceptance; <=1% latent RMS; independent margins positive by-character intervals plus content preservation.
pilot_gate.next_action: Expand heldout character/seed coverage and audit trainable DiT/FM gradients before any training; no automatic D2/D3.

practical_transfer_review.interpretation: Weak positive cross-encoder margin transfer exists, but large self-score improvement does not translate to robust independent writer identification. Single-step pilot only; do not infer D2 architecture will fix it.
